meta.title: Update SFTP status callback to output once per second
meta.body_summary: Rate-limit the SFTP status callback in sftpclient.c to output at most once per second to mitigate a high-bandwidth performance bottleneck.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added rate-limiting to SFTP status callback; JacobBarthelmeh requested variable declaration at top of scope per wolfSSL standard, then approved after fixes; merged with anecdotal high-bandwidth performance bottleneck evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 27 changed lines in one file, this is a very small edit by absolute volume, consistent with a small-step performance fix that merged after a coding-standard correction.

review_details.performance_claim: Reduce status output frequency to once per second to mitigate performance bottleneck on high-bandwidth connections.

maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED, Devin moved the elapsedTime declaration to the function top and addressed other minor issues; the PR was approved and merged.

core_change_summary.description: In examples/sftpclient/sftpclient.c, the myStatusCb callback was modified to skip output if the current second hasn't changed, using a static lastOutputTime. The timer is reset on new file transfers, and timeout checks were updated to use elapsed time. Build guards for WOLFSSH_NO_TIMESTAMP were adjusted and variable declarations moved to function scope per wolfSSL standards.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add time-based rate limiting to myStatusCb.

Subsequent commits: add timer reset for new files, fix Zephyr build by guarding lastOutputTime, move elapsedTime declaration to top of scope, fix timeout checks and error messages, adjust preprocessor guards.
